title: Replace Airtable with a Custom App Built in an Afternoon
summary: Replace Airtable with a custom app that has no row limits, no API rate caps, and no per-seat fees. Built in an afternoon with Blink — database and auth included.
body_markdown: Airtable connects natively to 700+ tools. A custom app needs API integrations for the same connections. If you use Airtable's Salesforce sync or Jira connector daily, factor in the API integration work before switching. If your main integrations are email notifications and form submissions, those are straightforward to replicate.
